title: Legal Discovery Intelligence Graph
summary: A deployed Graph RAG investigation workspace with cited evidence, entity graphs, and reproducible evaluation.
outcome: A live investigation workspace combining graph and vector retrieval with cited evidence.
evaluation: Graph retrieval R@5 is 0.929 and relationship hit@5 is 0.833.
operationalTradeoffs: The reproducible corpus is synthetic, so results are not claims about real legal matters.
Graph and vector systems are retained together to support complementary retrieval paths.
disclaimer: All documents, people, companies, amounts, and events are synthetic and fictional. The displayed results are reproducible evaluation results on a templated corpus.
